items.title: CCC Intelligent Solutions ends year-long LBO loan hiatus for software borrowers
items.summary: A new LBO-linked financing deal for a software company was launched in the leveraged loan market for the first time since the AI panic sell-off early this year. CCC Intelligent Solutions, a Chicago-based SaaS and AI platform provider to the P&C insurance industry for managing auto casualty claims, announced a $2.85 billion debt package on Nov. 9 via lead arranger JPMorgan, backing its buyout by a consortium of investors.
